name: Trustdata
description:
TrustData is a first-party marketing analytics platform built in the EU. It
measures traffic, conversions, multi-touch attribution, paid performance
across Google, Meta, TikTok and LinkedIn, SEO rankings, and how often AI
search engines such as ChatGPT, Perplexity and Gemini cite your brand.

This connector gives your AI governed access to that data. Ask for any
breakdown or time series: the server resolves your question into a validated
query against your workspace, or fails with an error that says how to fix the
call. Discovery tools list your properties, the query types your token can
reach, and the metrics each one carries, so agents compose correct queries
without guesswork.

It also closes the loop. Your AI can read TrustData's recommendations with
their evidence and expected impact, mark them done or dismiss them, log
change events such as deploys and campaign launches, and record experiment
verdicts. Over time your workspace holds a scored ledger of what was
recommended, what you did, and what happened.

Privacy is enforced at the source. Every query is scoped to the workspace you
authorize on the consent screen.

Connect your ad platforms, web analytics and store to TrustData, then connect
this to your AI: reporting, audits and reviews happen in the conversation,
with numbers that match your dashboard.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Trustdata to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Trustdata to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.trustdata.tech/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Trustdata MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Trustdata lists 33 MCP tools, including acknowledge_alert, ask_investigation, ask_investigation_followup, create_change_event, create_recommendation, dismiss_recommendation, get_attribution, get_geo, get_geo_visibility, get_investigation, get_ltv, and get_query_instructions.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Trustdata?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Trustdata in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
Trustdata requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Trustdata is developed by TrustData. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
